title: Implement slugify()
prompt: src/slugify.js exports slugify(text) but it is a stub. Implement it: lowercase, strip diacritics, replace every run of non-alphanumeric characters with a single hyphen, and trim leading/trailing hyphens. Use only the standard library.
acceptance: slugify() lowercases and strips diacritics [tests: strips diacritics, basic]
every run of non-alphanumeric characters becomes one hyphen [tests: collapses and trims whitespace, symbols become one separator]
leading and trailing hyphens are trimmed [tests: collapses hyphens and trims them]
